exceptions.title: works inside Popover
exceptions.reason: The case renders `Popover`, which Vase UI does not have.

exceptions.title: works inside Dialog
exceptions.reason: The case renders `Dialog.Trigger`, `Dialog.Portal` and `Dialog.Popup` from the entry point of Dialog. Vase UI does not have that entry point.

exceptions.title: renders a panel that suspends when opened with the boundary outside the root
exceptions.reason: React hides the mounted tree and shows the fallback when a panel suspends after the mount. A mounted Vue component cannot suspend again.

The part must tell an absent `defaultValue` from `defaultValue={0}`. Only the absent prop makes the root emit the initial change and fall back from a disabled tab. A Vue prop with a default cannot tell the two apart, so the prop has no default. The part uses `0` for an absent prop, which is the default that Base UI documents.
Base UI turns this file into `prehydrationScript.min.ts` with a minifier. No component imports the template. Vase UI has no minifier and copies the minified text.

surfaceAdditions.reason: The part reads `id` to give it to the root for the `aria-labelledby` of the panel, so it is a declared prop. Base UI reads it from the native attributes of the tab, and `types.md` has no row for a native attribute.

The part reads `id` to give it to the root for the `aria-controls` of the tab, so it is a declared prop. `types.md` has no row for a native attribute. Base UI gives the root a generated id, and an `id` of the consumer replaces only the id of the element.
